panels.description: Tracks whether the planner is producing plans and whether plan quality is improving or degrading over time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, avg(outcome_score::numeric) AS "Plan Score" FROM plan_journal WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*)::double precision AS "Plans Logged" FROM plan_journal WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Plan Score Trend & Planning Volume

panels.description: Shows planning behavior, compliance, or planning outcomes over time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT plan_id, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver', 'MM/DD HH:MI') AS "Created", COALESCE(outcome_score::text, '-') AS "Score", COALESCE(LEFT(hypothesis, 60), '-') AS "Hypothesis" FROM plan_journal ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Indoor temperature against the green firmware compliance band, with only the heat entry and fan/cooling entry thresholds rendered. Crop/planner provenance, dispatcher math, cfg readbacks, and padding details remain in the band traceability SQL contract.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.ts AS time, f.temp_f AS "Forecast Outdoor Temp" FROM weather_forecast f WHERE f.ts > now() - interval '72 hours' AND f.ts < now() + interval '24 hours' ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.ts AS time, avg(c.temp_avg) OVER (ORDER BY c.ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Actual Indoor Temp (15-sample rolling avg)" FROM climate c WHERE c.ts > now() - interval '72 hours' ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time,
    projected_temp_low::float AS "Compliant Low",
    projected_temp_high::float AS "Compliant High"
FROM fn_band_timeline($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), interval '30 minutes', 'vallery')
ORDER BY ts
SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 82 ELSE NULL END AS "Fan 1" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='fan1' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 84 ELSE NULL END AS "Fan 2" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='fan2' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 86 ELSE NULL END AS "Fog" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='fog' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 58 ELSE NULL END AS "Heat 1 (Electric)" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='heat1' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 56 ELSE NULL END AS "Heat 2 (Gas)" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='heat2' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Write Rate + Oscillations
Plans per day by instance (contract §2.F)
panels.description: Daily plan_journal write count split by planner_instance audit label. Bars stack to show total throughput; labels are historical audit metadata under Hermes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
       COALESCE(planner_instance, 'unknown') AS instance,
       count(*)::int AS plans
  FROM plan_journal
 WHERE created_at > $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo()
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: SLA breaches (last 24h)
panels.description: Count of planner_trigger_log rows that transitioned to status='timed_out' in the panel time range. Sparkline shows daily trend. Big number = today's count only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', delivered_at) AS time,
       count(*)::int AS "Timed out"
  FROM plan_delivery_log
 WHERE status = 'timed_out'
   AND delivered_at > $__timeFrom() AND delivered_at < $__timeTo()
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Plan-write latency by instance (trigger_id join)
panels.description: Distribution of seconds between plan_delivery_log.delivered_at and the matching plan_journal.created_at, one series per planner_instance audit label. Tail on the right = slow cycles. Bucketed at 5-second resolution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(pj.planner_instance, 'unknown') AS instance,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pj.created_at - ptl.delivered_at)::float AS latency_seconds
  FROM plan_journal pj
  JOIN plan_delivery_log ptl ON ptl.trigger_id = pj.trigger_id
 WHERE pj.created_at > $__timeFrom() AND pj.created_at < $__timeTo()
   AND pj.created_at >= ptl.delivered_at
 ORDER BY 2
